production._comment_autoIncrement: REMOVED deliberately. With appVersionSource:'local', autoIncrement made EAS bump android.versionCode / ios.buildNumber in app.json AT BUILD TIME and write the file back — so a commit made before the build was always stale by one, and the tag never matched the artifact in the store. app.json is now the single source of truth: bump version, versionCode and buildNumber by hand (see CLAUDE.md 'Release / deploy flow'), commit, then build. The cost is that a rebuild after a failed upload needs a manual bump, which fails loudly at the store rather than silently shipping a mismatched number.

testing._comment: Tester-only submission. Build with the SAME `production` BUILD profile (release signing, app-bundle, EXPO_PUBLIC_DISTRIBUTION=store) — only the destination differs. Android `alpha` is Play's Closed testing track; `internal` would be Internal testing, `beta` Open testing. iOS needs no track: uploading to App Store Connect makes the build available in TestFlight, and it is NOT released to the App Store until you separately submit it for review.
